# Techfahm Systems Inc.

> Techfahm is a managed IT services provider (MSP) for small and medium-sized businesses in Ontario, Canada, serving the Greater Toronto Area, Hamilton & Niagara, and the Waterloo Region. Contact: info@techfahm.com, +1 (905) 277-5653. Every engagement starts with a free consultation.

## Services
- [Network Management](https://techfahm.com/services/network-management/): monitoring of uptime, traffic and network health; administration, maintenance and security fixes.
- [Managed IT Support](https://techfahm.com/services/managed-it-support/): design, operation and maintenance of critical IT systems and help for staff.
- [Cloud Computing](https://techfahm.com/services/cloud-computing/): cloud storage, databases, analytics, software and networking.
- [Cybersecurity](https://techfahm.com/services/cybersecurity/): protection for SMBs against internal and external threats, multi-tier access control.
- [Backup & Disaster Recovery](https://techfahm.com/services/backup-and-disaster-recovery/): backups of essential data and a recovery action plan.
- [IT Consulting](https://techfahm.com/services/it-consulting/): personalised, scalable IT advice aligned with business goals.

## Industries
- [Health](https://techfahm.com/industry/health/): compliance support for PHIPA, PIPEDA and HIPAA; EMR/EHR maintenance; PS Suite, Xolomon, NextGen Healthcare, Kareo Clinical.
- [Manufacturing & Distribution](https://techfahm.com/industry/manufacturing-and-distribution/): supply chain IT; Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP.

- [Toronto and the GTA](https://techfahm.com/managed-it-services-toronto/)
